messages:
alex: Opening a tiny PR to add a compact troubleshooting playbook: streaming -> batch fallback when service returns repeated 429s during long completions. Will include node/python snippets, a sim curl, and a one-line remediation matrix.

maria: please include handling for Retry-After, and prefer full-jitter on top of exponential backoff. Call out trimming context when 409/413 appear.

jen: QA can validate if you add the exact dev-sim curl and a minimal harness that logs status + Retry-After header.

alex: added curl and a 6-line node harness in the draft: ```js
let tries=0;
try{const s=await client.stream(payload);await s.pipeTo(ui)}catch(e){if(e.status===429){tries++;await sleep(backoff(tries)+jitter());if(tries>=2){const r=await client.create(payloadNoStream);render(r)}}else throw e}
```

maria: small note: add brief Dedicated/Private differences: Dedicated -> pool saturation 429s, Private -> local proxy rules. One short sentence.

alex: done. Also added "when to escalate" bullets: consistent >1% 429s, route-wide 95th latency regression, or repeated stream-resume failures.

docs-bot: PR created by alex: #5102  reviewers requested: @maria @jen

jen: I'll run the sim and paste logs back here. If QA confirms the fallback works, we can merge as a small patch.

maria: thanks, will review code style and SDK error-code examples.

alex: thanks all, pushing updates now.
